To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
CSR intensity is positively related to corporate reputation, and that CSR intensity is not significantly related to financial performance.
CSR intensity is positively related to the corporate reputation of Indian firms and that corporate strategy and social initiatives are the most important drivers of corporate reputation.
corporate reputation and advertising are significant determinants of the relationship between CSR intensity and financial performance of the firm.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the impact of CSR intensity on corporate reputation.
the impact of CSR intensity, and its underlying factors, on the corporate reputation and financial profitability of firms in India.
how corporate social responsibility (CSR) influences firm performance in the Indian context and how corporate reputation and competition intensity mediate this relationship.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
CSR intensity of firms is positively associated with corporate reputation and corporate reputation is positively associated with firm performance.
CSR Intensity of Indian firms is positively and significantly linked to corporate reputation and profitability.
the study has found a significant relationship between the CSR intensity of a firm and its reputation, which has a significant impact on its financial performance.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the study provides empirical evidence that corporate reputation is a key factor in enhancing corporate financial performance.
the CSR activities of firms are positively related to the reputation of a firm and its performance.
corporate social responsibility is a significant determinant of corporate reputation, which in turn is a significant determinant in financial performance of a firm.
The main takeaway from our work is that
firms should invest in social initiatives and corporate strategy to enhance their corporate reputation.
the Indian corporate should focus on the social initiative and corporate reputation in enhancing their CSR activities and in turn their financial performance.
firms should focus on CSR activities that are aligned with their core business strategy and that are of high importance to their key stakeholders.
